bootSecondSimulator.command: xcrun simctl boot <lane-b-udid> && xcrun simctl bootstatus <lane-b-udid> -b

artifactAggregate.verificationCommand: find "$artifact_root" -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256
artifactAggregate.algorithm: sort artifact paths bytewise, emit one SHA-256 line per path in that order, concatenate those path-ordered lines, then SHA-256 the concatenation

experiments.name: xcodebuildmcp-2.7-snapshot-stress
experiments.command: four batches of 10 concurrent `npx --yes xcodebuildmcp@2.7.0 ui-automation snapshot-ui` calls, five per explicit UDID

experiments.name: atomic-axe-full-flow-initial
experiments.command: per lane, 20 concurrent iterations of `simctl install`, `simctl launch`, `simulator-lane axe -- swipe`, and `simulator-lane axe -- screenshot`
experiments.failure: AXe locator resolved the XcodeBuildMCP package symlink one directory too far; the loop recorded failures but intentionally did not fail its parent shell

experiments.name: atomic-axe-full-flow-clean
experiments.command: per lane, 20 concurrent iterations of `simctl install`, `simctl launch`, `simulator-lane axe -- swipe`, and `simulator-lane axe -- screenshot`

experiments.name: serialized-fallback
experiments.command: five full install/launch/swipe/screenshot iterations on lane A, followed by five on lane B

experiments.name: persistent-driver-candidate
experiments.command: start two `npx --yes xcodebuildmcp@2.7.0 mcp` processes; initialize each over JSON-RPC; set and show a different exact simulatorId; terminate each captured session with SIGINT
experiments.terminationExitStatusReason: expected CLI status after captured SIGINT

experiments.name: parallel-clean-builds
experiments.command: two simultaneous xcodebuild invocations with distinct DerivedData, clonedSourcePackagesDirPath, and packageCachePath roots

experiments.name: concurrent-video
experiments.command: two simultaneous AXe 1.8.0 record-video commands routed by exact UDID

experiments.name: abandoned-lease-recovery-cli-smoke
